items.problem: Step 4 says "For the performance and UI quality results, does not return to 2 and puts them in the build report", but `ogw check --loop` no longer has a `performance` check (tools/ogw.md `## check`: the check names are `regression test`, `static check`, `no blocker`, `full flow`, `UI quality`, `no placeholder`; removed in 29e42e4). tools/ogw.md:770 `## checks` of `## build report` lists only "The UI quality results of the last `check-<iteration>.json` of the run", and tools/src/commands/build/lib/report-sections.ts `checksBody` copies only `UI quality`. So the two defining documents differ about which loop check results go in the build report. The `build` procedure and `ogw build report` own this, not `ogw build run`
